# MDN041 `out-of-line-attribute`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An attribute given in a separate statement (`dimension a(n)`, `intent(in) :: x`, `parameter (...)`).

## Why

Attribute statements scatter the description of one variable over several lines: the reader must
collect them to know what the variable is. Give the attributes in its type declaration.

## Reported

```fortran
real :: a
dimension a(10)
intent(in) :: a
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real, dimension(10), intent(in) :: a
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN041] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN041` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD041` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
